products.description: List of line items read from the document, in order of appearance

name.description: Product name exactly as it appears on the document

value.description: Line item price as an integer in the currency's minor unit, e.g. 5.00 PLN = 500, $4.99 = 499. Never use decimal numbers.

currency.description: Currency in ISO 4217 format, e.g. PLN, EUR, USD

total.description: Grand total as read from the document (not computed from the line items)

value.description: Grand total as an integer in the currency's minor unit, e.g. 123.45 PLN = 12345
